draft.subject: ordering on your website
draft.body:
Hi Hector,

A different angle. Your website has no online ordering portal, so every order has to be keyed in by hand.

We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards.

Would letting customers order online be useful?

evidence.text: Order Desk Associate. Take customer orders by phone and email and enter them into our order system.
No online ordering portal, customer login or EDI page was found on the website.
